sample_unit: panoramic radiographs (82 implant-present with 297 fixtures, 82 implant-absent), five runs each

links.outcome: Run-to-run reproducibility of implant fixture detection across five independent runs
links.effect: Fixtures detected in all five runs were 1.01% (GPT-4o), 22.22% (OpenAI o3), and 25.93% (GPT-5T).
links.quote: The fixtures detected in all five runs were 1.01 % (GPT-4o), 22.22 % (OpenAI o3), and 25.93 % (GPT-5T).

links.outcome: Zero-shot localization performance of general-purpose multimodal LLMs on dental radiographs
links.effect: Micro sensitivity was 16.97% for GPT-4o, 68.82% for o3, and 65.66% for GPT-5T; specificity on implant-absent images 32.68%, 65.85%, 68.54%.
links.quote: Reasoning-focused multimodal LLMs outperformed GPT-4o in zero-shot implant fixture localization and reduced false positives, but moderate sensitivity, restoration-driven errors, and run-to-run variability limit autonomous clinical use.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and consistency of off-the-shelf multimodal LLMs (GPT-4o, OpenAI o3, GPT-5T) on a dental panoramic radiography benchmark without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
